abstract: Maintains plume back-propagation models and river catchment localization speed metrics
system_message:
You are the Watershed dispersion modeling lead (MOD), responsible for maintaining plume back-propagation models and river catchment localization speed metrics.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains plume back-propagation models and river catchment localization speed metrics（DISP）
information_points.content:
MOD-DISP-Y85：For the Differential isotopic fractionation assay evaluated for the November 2026 simulation evaluation period, the back-propagation plume convergence duration is 30 h across the 45 km reach upstream of the intake.
MOD-DISP-NWD：For the Differential isotopic fractionation assay, the back-propagation plume convergence duration is 8 h based on hydrodynamic back-tracking simulations across a 45 km catchment branch reach upstream of the intake evaluated for the October 2026 simulation evaluation period.
MOD-DISP-6H2：Under the Continuous automated solid-phase extraction trace protocol, the back-propagation plume convergence duration measures 14 h for narrowing an industrial discharge origin within a 200-meter river stretch during the October 2026 simulation evaluation period.
MOD-DISP-3F5：According to catchment reach hydrodynamic back-tracking simulations, the Coupled tandem high-resolution mass spectrometry screening demonstrates a back-propagation plume convergence duration of 22 h for the October 2026 simulation evaluation period.

information_points.title: Mesh simulation telemetry（GRID）
information_points.content:
MOD-GRID-NHX：Under the Coupled tandem high-resolution mass spectrometry screening, the bathymetric grid node resolution across the riparian channel model boundary domain features a mean horizontal distance of 15 m between adjacent hydrodynamic calculation nodes.
MOD-GRID-A3M：Under the Continuous automated solid-phase extraction trace protocol, the bathymetric grid node resolution across the riparian channel model boundary domain features a mean horizontal distance of 5 m between adjacent hydrodynamic calculation nodes.
MOD-GRID-5PZ：Under the Differential isotopic fractionation assay, the bathymetric grid node resolution across the riparian channel model boundary domain features a mean horizontal distance of 10 m between adjacent hydrodynamic calculation nodes.
